  • Profissional qualificado conforme norma ABNT NBR-15218 com qualificação nível I.
  • Experiência comprovada de, pelo menos, 2 (dois) anos.

Vale Alimentação

Plano de Saúde

*Necessário morar na cidade de Fortaleza ou região

Uma empresa com engenharia genuinamente brasileira

"Na PERBRAS, valorizamos a inclusão. Se você é PCD, queremos conhecê-lo melhor e incentivar para que faça parte da nossa equipe. Inscreva-se nas nossas vagas!"

A Perbras é uma empresa que atua na prestação de serviços e locação de equipamentos no setor de óleo e gás desde meados 1966. Desde então sempre acreditou e desenvolveu o potencial de seu corpo técnico e administrativo, alcançando em 1980 o patamar de ser uma empresa 100% brasileira.

Somos especialistas na prestação de serviços com sondas de produção de petróleo e gás natural (onshore e offshore). Ao longo dos anos, a Perbras ampliou seu portfólio de serviços, executando atividades em todas as regiões do Brasil nos mais diversos segmentos da cadeia produtiva do petróleo, prestando serviços complementares e ampliando sua participação no mercado através da parceria com diversas empresas do segmento de engenharia e de óleo e gás.

A Perbras atualmente tem sede na cidade de Catu, no estado da Bahia, a cerca de 80 km da capital Salvador, por entender sua responsabilidade social quanto ao desenvolvimento econômico da região. Todavia, atualmente possui filiais nos estados do Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo, Sergipe, Rio Grande do Norte, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina, Ceará e Pará.

Sondas de Produção de Petróleo (SPTs) – Unidades de Negócio

Primeira atividade desenvolvida pela Perbras, a atuação em campos onshore com SPT – Sondas de Produção Terrestres é a especialidade do corpo técnico da empresa que ao longo dos anos foi estimulada, preparada e desenvolvida nas mais persas áreas para poder atender as múltiplas demandas do cliente, do mercado e da sociedade.

Operamos com Sondas de Produção Terrestre com capacidade entre 60.000lb e 300.000lb, aptas para realizar qualquer tipo de intervenção em poços de petróleo e gás natural, atendo princípios de Qualidade, Segurança e Meio Ambiente.

Outros Serviços (OS) – Unidades de Negócio

No final da década de 90, a Perbras já consolidada no mercado de SPT no Brasil, decide ampliar seu portfólio através dos demais serviços existentes ao longo da cadeia produtiva da indústria petrolífera. Surge o primeiro contrato de Sonolog e Dinamômetro que realizava a medição de nível de produção, diagnóstico de hastes e bombas de poço, intitulado de Outros Serviços para estabelecer a diferenciação com o negócio predominante da empresa.

“Outros Serviços” possibilitaram que a Perbras pudesse atender a Petrobras e outros clientes nos mais diversos segmentos, desafiando seu corpo técnico e de gestores a buscar cada vez mais habilidades e conhecimentos para prestar serviços com a mesma qualidade já comprovada no mercado de SPT.

Alguns dos serviços prestados pela Pebras:

  • Manutenção e montagem de equipamentos onshore e offshore;
  • Circulação de óleo quente e água quente em poços;
  • Circulação de vapor em poços e instalações (caldeira móvel);
  • Medição de vazão em poços de injeção e captação de água;
  • Serviços de QSMS;
  • Isolamentos térmicos;
  • Unidade de arame slickline (onshore e offshore);
  • Operação complementar de plataformas marítimas;
  • Apoio em terminais portuários de petróleo e gás natural;
  • Aferição e calibração de medidores de vazão;
  • Planejamento, controle e manutenção mecânica de equipamentos dinâmicos;
  • Apoio às operações de barco e de salvatagem nas plataformas marítima etc.

Perbras Gestão Integrada

Atualmente a Perbras possui certificações com base na NBR ISO 9001 (Qualidade), OHSAS 18001 (Segurança e Saúde no Trabalho), NBR ISO 14001 (Gestão Ambiental). Somos certificados na API 4F pela American Petroleum Institute como fabricantes de Sondas de Produção de Petróleo.

A Perbras presta serviços sob demanda para atividades de perfuração, produção e manutenção de poços de petróleo e afins, com ou sem fornecimento de equipamentos, bem como a manutenção dos equipamentos utilizados nessas operações.

Nós adotamos a integração da Gestão da Qualidade, do Meio Ambiente, da Segurança e Saúde no Trabalho para atingir seus objetivos e tem como compromissos:

  • Prestar serviços com qualidade e integridade, atendendo aos requisitos contratuais dos clientes;
  • Promover a conscientização e o comprometimento dos colaboradores com o SGI;

Com 26 anos de atuação no litoral norte de Santa Catarina e mais de 250 colaboradores, a instituição já tem mais de 96 mil cooperados que são beneficiados pelas soluções financeiras e pelo atendimento personalizado.

description:
Technical Specialist I, Biofuels, Lifecycle, GHG

SCS Global Services Hybrid · Brasília … 2 days ago

Job Description

Company Overview SCS Global Services is a pioneer and leader in sustainability standards and third‑party certification, serving natural resources, built environment, food & agriculture, consumer products, and climate sectors for over 40 years. As a Benefit Corporation, the company is committed to socially and environmentally responsible business practices and uses sound science to drive positive change.

Job Overview Recent growth in Renewable Fuels and Circular Economy has increased interest in certification programs such as ISCC EU, ISCC PLUS, RSB EU RED, and RSB Advanced Products. SCS has developed standardized protocols to evaluate GHG emissions from Life‑Cycle Assessments (LCAs) of biofuels and biobased products. The Technical Specialist I supports the ISCC and RSB certification teams globally, primarily conducting remote GHG reviews.

Relevant Standards/Schemes

  • International Sustainability & Carbon Certification (ISCC)
  • Roundtable on Sustainable Biomaterials (RSB)

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Technical Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Review (95%)

  • Complete and deliver GHG reports and related comments to auditors and program staff on time and according to program requirements
  • Interact with clients and audit teams to follow up on nonconformity closure when necessary
  • Support the development of new procedures and processes to review GHG calculations efficiently and effectively
  • Communicate in a timely and professional manner with internal staff and external clients

Greenhouse Gas LCA Calculations (5%)

  • Occasional support to companies not being certified by SCS to perform GHG emissions calculations (consulting activity)

Quality and Program Development

  • Deliver verification services in accordance with SCS Corporate and Program Quality requirements
  • Support the SCS quality management system through maintenance of competency records, training logs, calibration activities, and up‑to‑date knowledge of program and external scheme requirements

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree in a technical field (e.g., chemistry or related) with 2+ years of experience completing LCAs for biofuels or bio‑based materials, according to ISO 14040/44 requirements, **or**
  • Bachelor’s Degree in a technical field (e.g., chemistry or related) with 5+ years of experience completing LCAs for biofuels or bio‑based materials, according to ISO 14040/44 requirements
  • Experience using ecoinvent database and major LCA software (e.g., SimaPro, GaBi, openLCA)
  • Experience working with international biofuels LCA models, including the EU RED (e.g., Biograce, GHGenius, RenovaCalc, GREET)
  • Understanding of Life‑Cycle Accounting principles, according to ISO 14064/65 and other international standards and guidelines (e.g., PEF framework, WRI GHG Protocol, Together for Sustainability guideline)
  • Strong technical writing, organization, and prioritization skills
  • Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines
  • Strong customer service and teamwork orientation
  • Complete fluency in English with professional experience that involves written and verbal communication
  • Proficient with business software including Outlook, Word, Excel, and database management
  • Initiative, good judgment, and ability to work independently under pressure in a changing environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in a technical field (e.g., chemistry or related)
  • Experience working with soil carbon accumulation and related models (e.g., RothC model, Century model, DAYCENT model)
  • Experience with LCA and GHG accounting for green hydrogen and e‑fuels
  • Knowledge of biofuel production, including biodiesel, HVO/renewable diesel, sustainable aviation fuel, and ethanol
  • Experience with bio‑based materials carbon intensity calculation, including bio‑based plastics and chemicals
  • Multi‑language proficiency

The above description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Additional duties outside of normal responsibilities may be required from time to time as assigned.

Working Remotely

SCS is recruiting all open roles to be remote, allowing employees the flexibility to work from home and enabling the company to diversify its workforce. This is a home‑office based role and may include local, domestic, and/or international travel, as clarified during the recruitment process.

Estimated Monthly Salary

12,000 – 15,000 BRL

SCS complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. title: Country Lead, Brazil
description:
Samba TV tracks streaming and broadcast video across the world with our proprietary data and technology. We are on a mission to fundamentally transform the viewing experience for everyone. Our data enables media companies to connect with audiences for new shows and movies, and enables advertisers to engage viewers and measure reach across all their devices. We have an amazing story with a unique perspective on culture formed by a global footprint of data and AI-driven insights.

Samba TV is entering the Brazilian market, and we're looking for an entrepreneurial, multi-disciplinary consultant to lead the charge on the ground. This is a true 0-to-1 opportunity: you won't inherit a playbook — you'll write it. You'll combine commercial acumen, business development instincts, and technical fluency to establish Samba TV's presence, build partnerships, drive initial revenue, and shape go-to-market products tailored to local market conditions and regulatory requirements.

This role sits at the intersection of commercial partnerships, business development, solutions engineering, and market strategy. We need someone who can pitch to senior brand and agency contacts in the morning, troubleshoot data integrations in the afternoon, and brief our product team on local market requirements in the evening. If you thrive in ambiguity, build structure where none exists, and are energized by the prospect of building a new market from scratch — this role is for you.

This is a contract / consultant engagement based in São Paulo. The initial engagement period will be defined based on mutual alignment, with the potential for extension or conversion based on market traction and business needs. Travel within Brazil is expected; occasional travel to Samba TV offices in the US or other international locations may be required.

What You'll Do

Own the commercial strategy for Brazil: identify target accounts, build pipeline, and close initial deals across agencies, advertisers, and media companies.

  • Take a consultative approach to sales — educate the market on Samba TV's data, measurement, and audience solutions while adapting value propositions to local needs.
  • Develop and execute account plans for key prospects, manage the full sales cycle from prospecting through close, and maintain accurate forecasting.
  • Identify, evaluate, and negotiate strategic partnerships with local broadcasters, OEMs, data providers, platforms, and technology partners critical to Samba TV's Brazil infrastructure.
  • Map the Brazilian media, advertising, and data ecosystem — understand who the key players are, where the opportunities lie, and what partnerships unlock scale.
  • Serve as the technical point of contact for prospects and partners — scope integrations, troubleshoot implementation questions, and translate Samba's product capabilities into client-specific solutions.
  • Provide technical pre-sales support: run product demos, respond to RFIs/RFPs, and build proof-of-concept solutions that demonstrate value.
  • Develop a comprehensive Brazil market entry strategy encompassing regulatory landscape, competitive positioning, data privacy compliance (LGPD), partnership requirements, and revenue projections.
  • Build the operational foundation for Samba's Brazil presence — define processes, reporting cadences, and success metrics.
  • Provide regular market updates and strategic recommendations to Samba's international and executive leadership.

Who You Are

Entrepreneurial builder with 10+ years of commercial experience in ad tech, media, data, or DaaS/SaaS — with a proven track record of launching products, entering new markets, and closing deals in Brazil or broader Latin America.

  • Commercially sharp and strategically minded: you've built pipelines, closed deals, and thought beyond quota to build something new, whether through a consulting, market entry, or strategic commercial background.
  • Technically fluent: you understand APIs, data integrations, programmatic ecosystems, and measurement methodologies well enough to hold your own in technical conversations and troubleshoot client implementations.
  • Deeply networked across the Brazilian ecosystem: established relationships with agencies, broadcasters, platforms, and advertisers, including major holding companies such as Publicis, WPP, Omnicom, Dentsu, Havas, and IPG.
  • Knowledgeable about the Brazilian media and data landscape: including the television ecosystem (Globo, SBT, Record, RedeTV!, pay TV, OTT/streaming, ACR/smart TV), audience data, cross-screen measurement, and data privacy regulations (LGPD).
  • Trilingual: native or professional fluency in Portuguese, English, and Spanish is required.
  • Self-directed and cross-functional: you operate with significant autonomy, set your own priorities, and collaborate effectively across sales, product, engineering, legal, and marketing, often across time zones.
  • Comfortable at the executive level: confident presenting to C-suite buyers and navigating complex, enterprise-level negotiations.
  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree from a top-tier program is preferred.

description:
Veja agora as 53 vagas para o Concurso Prefeitura Prefeitura de Guarulhos para cargos de nível fundamental e médio.

A Prefeitura de Guarulhos abre concurso públicocom 53 vagas em vários cargos. As oportunidades são para nível fundamental e médio. De acordo com a Secretária de Gestão do Departamento de Recursos Humanos, as vagas para preenchimento dos cargos são:

  • Agente de Serviço de Saúde,
  • Auxiliar em Saúde,
  • Condutor de Veículo de Urgência,
  • Técnico de Saúde entre outros.

A princípio o concurso será realizado, organizado e aplicado através da Fundação VUNESP . Então, acompanhe mais detalhes e as demais vagas abaixo!

Remuneração e atribuições para Concurso Prefeitura de Guarulhos

São diversas as vagas disponíveis, uma vez que a remuneração está de acordo com o edital do concurso publicado no site Vunesp. Salário de R$ 1.213,96 e R$ 2.076,93 para cargos de nível fundamental. Todavia, os cargos de nível médio a remuneração está entre R$ 2.307,74 e valor de R$ 2.251,23.

Requisitos para concurso da Prefeitura de Guarulhos

1- Agente de Serviço de Saúde

Para o cargo de Agente de Saúde, visto que são 03 as vagas, é exigido que o candidato tenha concluído o Ensino Fundamental. Sobretudo, o Agente de Saúde trabalha no setor de Zoonoses e Dengue.

2- Auxiliar em Saúde

Para o cargo de Auxiliar em Saúde com 01 vaga é exigido que o candidato tenha concluído o Ensino Fundamental, bem como tenha o Certificado de Curso Técnico de Gesso ou Mobilização Gessada. O Auxiliar em Saúde trabalha com imobilização ortopédica.

3- Condutor de Veículo de Urgência

Para o cargo de Condutor de Veículo de Urgência, visto que são 02 (duas) vagas em aberto é exigido que o candidato tenha concluído o Ensino Médio, que tenha Carteira Nacional de Habilitação com a Categoria “D” e Curso de Capacitação em Condução de Transportes de Emergência. É também necessário que apresente o certificado de conclusão do Curso de Condutores de Veículo de Transportes de Emergência. Este certificado é emitido pelas instituições que são credenciadas pelo Detran.

4- Agente de Serviços de Saúde

Para o cargo de Agente de Serviços de Saúde com 01 (uma)vaga é exigido que o candidato tenha concluído o Ensino Fundamental. O Agentede Serviços de Saúde trabalha com necropsia e o salário é de R$1.618,57.

Para participar do Concurso Prefeitura de Guarulhos o cargo de Atendente SUS, visto que são 20 (vinte) vagas é exigido que o candidato tenha concluído o Ensino Médio O salário para esse cargo é de R$ 2.501,38.

6- Auxiliar em Saúde Bucal

Para o cargo de Auxiliar em Saúde Bucal, visto que são 04 (quatro) vagas é exigido que o candidato tenha concluído o Ensino Médio e ter Curso de Auxiliar de Saúde Bucal com registro no Conselho Profissional. O salário para esse cargo é de R$ 2.501,38.

7- Prático (a) em Farmácia

Para o cargo de Prático (a) em Farmácia com 01 (uma)vaga é exigido que o candidato tenha concluído o Ensino Médio. O salário para ocargo é de R$ 2.081,89.

8- Técnico (a) de Diagnósticos

Para o cargo de Prático Técnico (a) de Diagnósticos com01 (uma) vaga é exigido que o candidato tenha concluído o Ensino Médio e CursoTécnico em Eletroencefalografia e registro no conselho profissional. O Saláriopara o cargo é de R$ 1.666,41.

9- Técnico (a) de Saúde (Enfermagem)

Para o cargo de Técnico (a) de Saúde, visto que são 15 (quinze) vagas é exigido que o candidato tenha concluído o Ensino Médio e Curso Técnico em Enfermagem e registro no COREN. O Salário para o cargo é de R$ 2.251,23.

10- Técnico (a) de Saúde (Necropsia)

Para o cargo de Técnico (a) de Saúde com 01 (uma) vagaé exigido que o candidato tenha concluído o Ensino Médio e Curso Técnico emNecropsia. O Salário para o cargo é de R$ 2.501,38.

11- Técnico (a) de Saúde (Radiologia)

Para o cargo de Técnico (a) de Saúde, visto que são 02 (duas) vagas é exigido que o candidato tenha concluído o Ensino Médio e Curso Técnico em Radiologia e registro no Conselho Regional dos Técnicos em Radiologia. O Salário para o cargo é de R$ 1.965,40.

As inscrições para o Concurso Prefeitura de Guarulhos serão promovidas pelo site , sobretudo com os seguintes requisitos, taxa cobrado de acordo com o nível escolar. Sendo assim, cargos de nível fundamental o valor das inscrição é R$43,53, já para cargos de nível médio o valor é R$64,82.

Grupo Ultra

A Ultra já nasceu acreditando que o esporte e a atividade física são capazes de transformar nós mesmos, o outro e também a sociedade.

Todos nós temos o poder de fazer a diferença. E se o mundo está tão diferente por que as academias são todas iguais?

Chegamos para fazer diferente.

Propósito

Existimos para ser uma ferramenta poderosa de transformação através de atividades física e esportes. Nascemos como um agente incansável de mudanças, incentivando, motivando e oferecendo a estrutura e serviços adequados para a prática de exercícios.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições do cargo

  • Supervisionar e coordenar a equipe e atividades da unidade.
  • Elaborar relatórios e atualizar relatórios com os indicadores e performance da unidade.
  • Monitorar os indicadores de desempenho da unidade e avaliar a equipe de forma coletiva e individual.
  • Participar, acompanhar e solucionar (quando possível) os itens avaliados em auditorias internas.

  • Tratar e solucionar os conflitos com os alunos.
  • Supervisionar o atendimento de toda a equipe.
  • Controlar o estoque e suprimentos para unidade.
  • Coordenar toda a manutenção predial e de equipamentos, solicitar orçamentos e pesquisar melhores preços.
  • Entrevistar e selecionar pessoas para fazer parte da equipe (quando necessário).

  • Gerenciar o ponto eletrônico da unidade.
  • Auxiliar no processo administrativo da unidade, como admissão, demissão, férias, faltas, marcação de ponto, escala de trabalho, fechamento da folha, etc.
  • Zelar pela perfeita conservação, limpeza, proporcionando ordem no local de trabalho.
  • Executar outras tarefas correlatadas, conforme necessidade do serviço e orientação do superior imediato.

Ensino superior em Educação Física, desejável graduação adicional em Administração, Gestão de Negócios ou Pessoas.

  • Pontual e organizado(a).

title: CRA II
description:
Summary Of Responsibilities

  • Site management responsibility for clinical studies according to Fortrea’s Standard Operating Procedures, ICH GCP Guidelines, applicable project plans and Sponsor requirements, including verification of study training records.
  • Conduct site monitoring responsibilities for clinical trials according to Fortrea’s Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), ICH guidelines and GCP; including Pre-study, Site Initiation, Process Monitoring, Routine Monitoring, and Close-out Visits.
  • Prepares and implements project plans related to Clinical Monitoring responsibilities.
  • Ensures the protection of subjects by verifying that informed consent procedures and protocol requirements are adhered to alongside applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Safeguards data integrity by careful source document review, source document verification, query generation, and resolution against established data review guidelines on Fortrea or client data management systems.
  • Confirms Site Regulatory documents and applicable eTMF/Sponsor Documents are complete and current throughout the duration of the trial.
  • Guarantees that the study Investigational Product inventory and accountability is accurate and that study materials are stored securely and per protocol requirements.
  • Ensures adherence to global quality control and CRA performance metrics.
  • Ensures audit readiness at site level.
  • Acts in the project role of a Lead CRA as assigned.
  • General On-Site Monitoring Responsibilities:
  • Ensure the study staff who will conduct the protocol have received the proper materials and instructions to safely enter subjects/patients into the study. Ensure the protection of study subjects or patients by performing eligibility review, verifying that screening, informed consent procedures and protocol requirements are adhered to according to the applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Ensure the integrity of the source data reported by careful source document review. Monitor data for missing or implausible data.
  • Ensure study data completeness, accuracy, consistency, and compliance; identify deficiencies, deviations and discrepancies, and initiate corrective action as required.
  • Ensure the resources of the Sponsor and Fortrea are spent wisely by performing the required monitoring tasks in an efficient manner, according to SOPs and established guidelines, including managing travel expenses in an economical fashion according to Fortrea travel policy.
  • Travel, including air travel, may be required and is an essential function of the job.
  • Prepare and submit accurate and timely trip reports.
  • Independently perform eCRF review, 100% source data verification, query generation and resolution against established data review guideline with or without direct supervision, on Fortrea or client data management systems, as assigned by management.
  • Assist with the administration of clinical research projects, recruiting investigators (if applicable), collecting investigator documentation and site management.
  • Update, navigate, and maintain Fortrea or study/Sponsor-specific trial management tools/eClinical systems.
  • Track IP shipments and supplies, as needed.
  • Track and follow-up on serious adverse events as assigned.
  • Work closely with the study team, align monitoring to critical study timelines ensuring study deliverables are met.
  • Prepare and implement study-specific monitoring plans and site Initiation slides, as assigned.
  • Attend investigators’ meetings (if applicable), project team meetings and teleconferences, and others as needed.
  • Present training content for site initiation.
  • Assist with training of new employees (e.g., co-monitoring).
  • All other duties as needed or assigned.

Qualifications (Minimum Required)

  • University or college degree, or certification in a related allied health profession from an appropriately accredited institution (e.g., nursing licensure). An equivalent amount of experience can be substituted as appropriate.
  • Thorough understanding of ICH GCP Guidelines and understanding of local regulatory requirements.
  • Thorough knowledge of monitoring procedures.
  • Basic understanding of the clinical trial process.
  • Fluent in local office language and in English, both written and verbal.
  • Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements.

Experience (Minimum Required)

  • External Candidates: University or college degree, or certification in a related allied health profession from an appropriately accredited institution (e.g., nursing licensure). AND
  • A minimum of 2 years of Clinical Monitoring experience.
  • Internal Candidates: Internal candidates with a minimum of 2 years of Clinical Monitoring experience.
  • Ability to monitor study sites independently according to monitoring plan, project requirements, SOPs, and ICH GCP guidelines.
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision.
  • Have an understanding of the Serious Adverse Event (SAE) reporting, process production of reports, narratives and follow up of SAEs.
  • Good planning, organization, and problem‑solving abilities.
  • Works efficiently and effectively in a matrix environment.

Preferred Qualifications Include

  • Thorough working knowledge of Fortrea SOPs for site monitoring.
  • One (1) or more additional years of experience in a related field (i.e., medical, clinical, pharmaceutical, laboratory, research, data analysis, data management or technical writing) is preferred.
  • Phase I monitoring experience.
  • Life Science or Nursing qualification.
  • Specific skills, systems, certifications, and/or licenses preferred.
  • Personal characteristics (leadership, problem solving, interpersonal skills).
  • Good attention to detail.
  • Methodical approach to work.
  • Good understanding of medical and clinical research terminology and clinical research processes.
  • An understanding of the basics of physiology, pharmacology, and medical devices (when applicable).
  • Good understanding of the principles of ICH GCP, ISO 14155 (if applicable) and local regulatory requirements.
  • Good computer literacy with working knowledge of PCs, Windows and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Good oral and written internal and external communication. Strong interpersonal team and organizational skills, personal presentation. The ability to communicate effectively in English.
  • Focus on Customer.
  • Innovate and Change.
  • Pursue Scientific and Process Excellence.
  • Work with Others.
  • Achieve Results.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality of data and information during interactions with staff at all levels and across studies and sponsors.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct clinical operations activities most effectively and efficiently.
  • Good analytical and negotiation skills.
  • Experience using e-clinical systems (e.g., clinical trial management system (CTMS)).
  • For medical device positions, experience in providing customer service to device end users.

Physical Demands/Work Environment

  • Must be able to sit at a computer for long periods of time.
  • Must be able to use hands to finger, handle or touch objects, tools or controls, including a computer keyboard, for up to 8 hours per day.
  • Standard office and/or home working environment.
  • Clinical Research Unit and hospital environment (administrative only).
  • Risk of eye strain.
  • Will involve outside of normal office hours as required by the role.
  • Travel Requirement is 60% of the time (traveling to study sites).

title: Product Manager
description:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Adyen is looking for a Product Manager to help scale our acquiring and payments capabilities across LATAM.

In this role, you will focus on building and improving core acquiring services, enabling merchants to process payments reliably, efficiently, and at scale across LATAM region.
As a Product Manager, you will have ownership over a defined product area and work hands‑on to deliver impactful solutions. You will collaborate closely with engineering, commercial, and operational teams to solve real merchant problems and improve our payments infrastructure in LATAM.
Product Managers at Adyen are responsible for delivering core payment product features to our merchants. You will work closely with global and local teams, including Engineering, Partnerships, Implementation Management, In‑Person and Online Payments, Compliance & Regulatory, and Commercial teams, to bring products from idea to market.

What you’ll do:

  • Shape the strategy: Contribute to the product vision and roadmap for your area, ensuring alignment with Adyen’s global and local priorities.
  • Own end‑to‑end product development: Identify high-impact problems, define solutions, and drive them from idea to launch — and beyond.
  • Drive discovery through collaboration: Work closely with merchants, engineers, and partners to deeply understand problems and validate solutions.
  • Stakeholder collaboration: Partner with commercial, development, legal, and operational teams to deliver products efficiently and with high quality.
  • Leverage data to inform decisions: Use data to understand performance, identify opportunities, and guide prioritization.
  • Drive product adoption and impact: Work with commercial and partner teams to ensure your product delivers real value to merchants and scales effectively.
  • Represent your product internally: Be the go‑to person for your product area, bringing clarity and alignment across teams.

Who you are:

  • Product Management: You have at least 5 years in product management, ideally within the payments ecosystem.
  • Customer centricity: You care about solving real customer problems and building products that create value.
  • Product thinking: You can translate strategy into clear problems, priorities, and solutions.
  • You build products, not just features: You focus on outcomes and long‑term impact, not just delivery.
  • You are adaptable and pragmatic: You navigate changing priorities and make progress in ambiguous environments.
  • You simplify complexity: You break down complex problems into actionable steps.
  • Data‑driven mindset: You use data to support decisions and measure success.
  • Strong communicator: You align teams, manage expectations, and communicate clearly across functions.
  • Technically curious: You are comfortable working with engineers and diving into technical topics when needed.
  • You have full professional proficiency (written and verbal) in English.

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

This role is based out of our São Paulo office. We are an office‑first company and value in‑person collaboration; we do not offer remote‑only roles.

  • Experiência em arquitetura e operação de sistemas distribuídos (preferencialmente com dados, analytics ou IA).
  • Vivência em equipes multidisciplinares com interação com produto, dados, segurança e arquitetura.
  • Graduação em TI, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

description:
DESCRITIVO SUMÁRIO

Atua como parceiro estratégico do CFO e das áreas de negócio, garantindo que as decisões estratégicas sejam sustentadas por análises financeiras robustas.

A posição tem papel central na gestão de caixa, estrutura de capital e monitoramento de performance por projeto (SPE), com forte interface com bancos e conselho. Atua diretamente na construção de modelos financeiros, definição de KPIs e produção de materiais executivos para suporte à tomada de decisão.

Inserido em um contexto de operação híbrida entre Minha Casa Minha Vida (escala e eficiência) e médio/alto padrão (margem e seletividade) , o profissional deverá equilibrar visão estratégica e execução, garantindo disciplina financeira e maximização de retorno.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS

  • Liderar o processo de orçamento anual, forecasts periódicos (rollling forecast) e plano estratégico de longo prazo (5 anos).
  • Consolidar projeções por SPE. Realizar projeções para os segmentos MCMV e Medio e Alto Padrao.
  • Desenvolver análises de sensibilidade (cenários macro, custo de obra, velocidade de vendas, velocidade de construcao, velocidade de repasse).
  • Desenvolver modelos de viabilidade econômica para novos empreendimentos, incluindo análise de VPL, TIR, Payback, fluxo de caixa e cenários de risco.
  • Acompanhar o desempenho dos projetos imobiliários em andamento, garantindo aderência às premissas financeiras definidas.
  • Elaborar e monitorar o fluxo de caixa corporativo, consolidado e por projeto, prevendo necessidades de capital e propondo estratégias de financiamento.
  • Monitorar e projetar necessidade de capital de giro.
  • Otimizar a estrutura de funding: SFH / Caixa (MCMV), CRI, Debentures ou Operações com Bancos Comerciais.
  • Apoiar decisões de alavancagem, dividendos e reinvestimento.
  • Estruturar e acompanhar indicadores gerenciais (KPIs), como margem do projeto, rentabilidade, giro, custo de obras, distratos, velocidade de vendas (VSO), ROE / ROIC, geração de caixa, entre outros.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a área de engenharia para validação de CAPEX e custos diretos/indiretos de obras.
  • Apoiar a área de incorporação na análise de compra de terrenos, valuation imobiliário e estruturação de parcerias (permuta vs caixa)
  • Garantir disciplina de investimento através de comitê de compra de terrenos.
  • Desenvolver apresentações e relatórios gerenciais para diretoria e conselho.
  • Avaliar impactos financeiros de políticas comerciais, campanhas, reajustes de preços e estratégias de vendas.
  • Garantir conformidade com normas contábeis, compliance financeiro, prazos de fechamento contábil e práticas de governança.
  • Realizar análise de balanço, demonstrações financeiras
  • Liderar equipe de analistas financeiros, promovendo desenvolvimento técnico e boas práticas analíticas.
  • Conduzir a negociação de taxas, prazos, garantias e condições financeiras junto às instituições bancárias, mantendo um relacionamento estratégico e ativo com os bancos para garantir acesso a linhas de crédito competitivas, financiamentos à produção e repasses, bem como assegurar agilidade nas aprovações, liberações e revisões de crédito.
  • Suportar CFO na relação com Bancos, Instituições Financeiras e Conselho.
  • Participar de operações estratégicas de captação e operações com recebíveis.
  • Atender auditoria interna e externa
  • Analisar e implementar a Reforma Tributária
  • Apoiar elaboração de operações societárias, constituição de SPEs, aumento/redução de capital, distribuição de lucros entre empresas do Grupo

REQUISITOS DO CARGO

Formação Acadêmica

  • Graduação em Contabilidade, Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Finanças, Controladoria, Gestão de Negócios ou similar é desejável.

Experiência

  • Experiência sólida em planejamento financeiro, controladoria ou FP&A (8-12 anos).
  • Vivência comprovada no setor de incorporação e construção civil
  • Conhecimento do Programa Minha Casa Minha Vida desejável .
  • Domínio de análise de viabilidade de empreendimentos imobiliários.
  • Atuação prévia com modelagem financeira avançada.

Competências Técnicas

  • Excel avançado/modelagem financeira (nível IB)
  • Conhecimento ERP utilizado no setor de incorporação imobiliária, (Mega/Senior) torna-se um diferencial
  • Conhecimento de:
  • Estrutura de SPEs
  • Funding imobiliário (CEF, CRI, etc.)
  • IFRS/CPC aplicáveis ao setor
  • Capacidade de construção de:
  • Business plans
  • Valuation (DCF, TIR por projeto)

Competências Comportamentais

  • Visão estratégica + capacidade de execução (“hands-on”)
  • Forte capacidade analítica e tomada de decisão
  • Comunicação executiva (interação com conselho e investidores)
  • Perfil de liderança e sucessão
  • Alta resiliência e senso de dono

title: Controllership Sr. Analyst
description:
Overview

SumUp enables businesses to get paid easily, process orders quickly, sell online instantly and manage their money more efficiently. We create the tools businesses need to make their business and their customer experience thrive!

You will be part of SumUp's Brazil Controlling team, sitting at the intersection of regulatory compliance, financial reporting, and strategic operations in one of the most complex and exciting fintech environments in Latin America. Operating within a regulated multi-entity structure, including SumUp IP and SumUp SCD, both supervised by the Brazilian Central Bank, our Controlling team ensures the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of financial information across all Brazilian legal entities.

This is a unique opportunity to join a lean, high-impact team at a critical inflection point. SumUp Brazil is actively pursuing a new financial license (SCFI — Sociedade de Crédito, Financiamento e Investimento), which will significantly expand the complexity and strategic importance of our local financial operations. You will contribute directly to the team's mission of building a more robust, scalable, and process-driven Controlling function, and your work will be visible at the highest levels of our global Finance organisation.

Reporting to the Entity Controller for Brazil, you will work closely with our Controlling Specialist, and engage regularly with our Global Accounting Operations, Tax, FP&A, Treasury and other teams across Brazil and Europe.

Responsibilities

  • Own and execute monthly Balance Sheet reconciliations and account substantiation packages for assigned Brazilian entities, ensuring accuracy and audit readiness at every close cycle
  • Execute Month-End Close (MEC) reviews across key areas including Fixed Assets, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Deferred Expenses, Deposits, LTN/LFT, Payments Transactions (TPV), Revenue Recognition, Prepayments, among others
  • Support the preparation and data gathering for Brazilian regulatory filings (ECD) in coordination with the Tax team
  • Reconcile intercompany balances with the Global Accounting Operations team and support CADOC regulatory reporting
  • Attend external auditors and contribute to the preparation of the Financial Statements and Automations project, helping build a more efficient and scalable preparation process for the financial statements of all Brazilian entities
  • Engage with multiple international stakeholders in English, supporting cross-functional requests from FP&A, Treasury, Global Process Owners, and external auditors

Qualifications

  • You have 4 to 6 years of experience in Controlling, Accounting, and/or Audit (Big4) in a structured finance environment, ideally within a regulated institution (bank, payment institution, or fintech)
  • You have solid, hands-on knowledge of Brazilian GAAP (BR GAAP) and IFRS fundamentals, with direct experience in month-end close and Balance Sheet reconciliations
  • You are familiar with Brazilian regulatory reporting requirements, and ideally have exposure to BCB/COSIF environments and CADOC reporting
  • You are proficient in SAP or an equivalent ERP, and have advanced GSheets/Excel skills
  • You are a proactive and reliable communicator, comfortable working with cross-functional and international teams in both Portuguese and English
  • You have a strong ownership mindset, you take your deliverables end-to-end, identify root causes, and propose solutions rather than just escalating problems
  • Experience with automation tools like Python, Zapier, Make.com and Langdock is a plus
  • Curiosity about AI tools to accelerate work and process improvements is highly valued
  • Experience with Financial Products like CDB, Derivatives, and Credit Card from an SCFI Company is a plus

Why you should join SumUp

  • Global Experience : Collaborate with a diverse team of 3,000+ people from over 90 countries, and join our global off-sites and hackathons.
  • 🤝 Collaborative Culture : Join a team that values diversity, innovation, and teamwork, where your ideas and contributions truly matter.
  • Career Growth : Be part of a global team working on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses.
  • Great Benefits : Health plans, meal vouchers (VR), Zenklub, Wellhub, life insurance, childcare allowance, and more.
  • Learning & Development : Access an annual budget of R$ 10,000 for education, certifications, and conferences.
  • Time Off : Enjoy 30 additional days off through our Break4Me program after 3 years at SumUp.
  • Grow with Us : Participate in our virtual stock program and benefit from SumUp’s success with company shares.

Learn More About SumUp

  • 🇧🇷 Office tour at São Paulo
  • Ask me anything: Engineering at SumUp
  • 🚀 SumUp’s Innovation Hackathon
  • 🤝 Get to know our hiring process

Ready to Join us?

Apply now and help us shape the future of financial solutions for small businesses

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: GTM Lead
description:
You will build Bleu's revenue machine from zero.

This is not a role where you inherit a pipeline and optimize it. There is no pipeline. There is:

  • real proof (strong case studies + references)
  • a clear quality bar and delivery track record
  • validated service patterns (we know what works)
  • founders who will work closely with you

Your job is to turn that into a repeatable GTM system.

What you'll own

  • Turn what we already do well into 2–3 clear, repeatable offers (less bespoke proposals every time)
  • Define who we're for — and who we're not for
  • Protect margin and apply guardrails (no vague scope, no "staff aug", no deals that create scope creep)
  • Build the basics in a CRM of your choice (stages, qualification criteria, templates, weekly cadence)
  • Create a proposal/contract process that fits consultative, high-trust sales
  • Close the loop with delivery so we keep selling what we're genuinely best at

Demand generation (hands-on)

  • Outbound + ecosystem work: LinkedIn, warm intros, partner conversations—in Bleu's voice (direct, consultative, substance > hype) — you prospect, qualify, and close while building the sales playbook
  • Turn proof into assets (references, case studies, short narratives) instead of "nice quotes"
  • Work with founders on a consistent content cadence (e.g., ~2 posts/week)

Team (once the system works)

  • Hire and manage a BDR to run the playbook you build, and/or build an AI agent for that.
  • Define what a "qualified meeting" is so the BDR generates real opportunities

What you won't own

  • Product decisions or roadmap
  • Delivery management or post-sale customer success
  • Engineering priorities or team management
  • Brand marketing / creative direction (you'll collaborate with cases and content creation, but you won't be "the brand team")

You'll do well here if you…

  • Have sold or built GTM for technical services / engineering partnerships / productized dev work (not enterprise SaaS-only)
  • Can hold a real conversation with technical buyers (founders, CTOs, eng leads) without fluff
  • Don't think that doing the prospecting yourself is unacceptable — you know that's the job
  • Write clearly and directly (if your default is buzzwords/corporate-speak, this won't fit)
  • Have high autonomy and like building systems (you don't need daily orchestration)
  • Know when to say no to deals that look good on paper but damage margin, scope, or team focus

Nice to have

  • Experience selling to technical buyers in both Web2 and Web3
  • Prior experience hiring/training a BDR
  • Familiarity with the Brazilian market (we're expanding Brazil as a channel too, without losing global focus)

Logistics

  • Remote (timezone range: UTC-8 to UTC+1)
  • Work closely with the founders (José + Fábio) and delivery leads

Hiring process (3–4 weeks)

  • 2. Paid async work sample (~3–4h) — ICP definition, offer framing, 30-day outbound plan, LinkedIn message, pipeline criteria
  • 3. Deep dive (90 min) — work sample presentation + discovery call roleplay + pressure scenarios
  • 4. Final conversation (45 min, both founders) — long-term alignment

Compensation

  • - Base + variable (OTE~ USD 100k/year)
  • - We use a fair ramp: early months focus on building the system and creating qualified pipeline before fully shifting incentives toward closed revenue
  • - Details shared in the interview process

Será responsável por apoiar o time comercial na elaboração de soluções técnicas, dimensionamento de projetos, especificação de produtos e relacionamento com clientes e parceiros.

Requisitos

  • Requisitos necessários: Experiência sólida em sistemas de segurança eletrônica (principalmente CFTV IP, analógico, híbrido, NVRs, DVRs, VMS) e controle de acesso, atuando diretamente em pré-vendas, projetos ou implantação.

    • Indústrias de porte médio;

  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de plantas arquitetônicas e diagramas de rede;
  • Conhecimentos em redes IP aplicadas a CFTV (endereçamento, VLAN, PoE, largura de banda, armazenamento);
  • Domínio de ferramentas de dimensionamento e softwares de projeto (preferencialmente dos próprios fabricantes ou similares);
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com facilidade em traduzir termos técnicos para linguagem de negócios;

Diferenciais (Desejáveis)

  • Certificações ou treinamentos específicos Hikvision, Dahua, Intelbras ou Axis.
  • Experiência com integrações de sistemas (controle de acesso + CFTV + alarme + analíticos);
  • Noções de segurança da informação aplicada a sistemas de vídeo em rede;
  • Experiência prévia em integradoras, distribuidores ou fabricantes de segurança eletrônica;
  • Vivência em elaboração de memoriais descritivos para licitações ou grandes contas.

Atividades

  • Elaborar soluções técnicas com base em produtos e tecnologias das marcas Hikvision, Dahua, Intelbras e Axis;
  • Fazer o dimensionamento de sistemas de CFTV, controle de acesso, alarmes e, quando aplicável, integração com outros sistemas;
  • Desenvolver propostas técnicas e auxiliar na composição de propostas comerciais (memoriais descritivos, listas de materiais, diagramas em alto nível);
  • Realizar apresentações técnicas e demonstrações de soluções para clientes e integradores;
  • Apoiar o time em visitas técnicas (presenciais ou remotas) para levantamento de requisitos e validação de cenários;
  • Analisar editais, RFPs e especificações técnicas, garantindo aderência da solução;
  • Acompanhar o pós-venda técnico de projetos junto ao time de implantação, garantindo a aderência ao que foi proposto;
  • Manter-se atualizado quanto às linhas de produtos, releases de firmware, softwares VMS/NVR e novas tecnologias das marcas atendidas.

title: Executive Assistant to CEO
description:
InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics.

Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast.

Our company culture blends people-first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symoolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens.

You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us.

Check out our Culture page here

About The Role

We’re looking for an Executive Assistant to provide high-level support to our CEO, Felix, and key stakeholders. You will be the backbone of our executive operations, ensuring that leadership can focus on scaling InPlanet while you manage the complexity of their daily lives with agility, trust, and extreme discretion.

You’ll be the kind of person who is a natural problem-solver, highly organized, and comfortable connecting the dots in a fast-paced environment—always maintaining the highest standards of discretion while handling sensitive information and founder-level matters with absolute trust. You’ll act as a true partner, managing priorities and communication to ensure our founders stay effective and focused on our mission.

The Impact you can make

Your work will directly increase the effectiveness of our CEO and leadership team. By bringing clarity to communication, structure to priorities, and ownership to execution, you enable faster and better decision-making across the company.

You won’t just manage tasks: you will own outcomes , ensuring that priorities move forward and nothing falls through the cracks.

Core working relationships

  • Felix (CEO) – direct report and primary priority for support
  • Key stakeholders (CFO, COO, co-founder) – occasional support for meetings, travel, and specific demands
  • External Partners – coordinating with notaries, providers, and global contacts

Key Responsibilities

  • Structure and manage complex calendars and meetings, prioritizing urgencies and ensuring a smooth schedule
  • Manage executive inboxes, including reading, drafting answers, and prioritizing threads and forwards
  • Provide support for personal agenda and private administrative tasks as needed to optimize the CEO's time
  • Join meetings to collect insights, document action items, and provide clear summaries
  • Lead certain initiatives from start to finish, such as scheduling notary dates and ensuring document readiness
  • Conduct research on specific topics and prepare detailed reports to support business decision-making
  • Organize end-to-end travel arrangements for the CEO and support other founders (COO/CFO) when required
  • Track deadlines and follow up on action items independently, ensuring tasks are completed on time
  • Maintain the highest standards of confidentiality and discretion when handling sensitive information
  • Identify and lead improvements in administrative processes to make them more efficient and scalable

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

  • Proven experience as an Executive Assistant or in a high-level coordination role
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related field
  • Advanced English and Portuguese communication skills
  • Strong ability to manage multiple priorities and complex schedules
  • Experience handling executive communication and correspondence
  • High level of autonomy and decision-making in ambiguous environments
  • Based in the Campinas / São Paulo region with availability for hybrid work:
    -2 days/week with Felix in Valinhos
    -Travels to Piracicaba

Key Qualities

  • Highly organized and naturally enjoys structuring, prioritizing, and bringing clarity
  • Detail-oriented and outcome-focused: you don’t just start tasks, you finish them
  • Proactive and independent, with confidence to move forward without constant approvals
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Able to connect the dots quickly and understand business context
  • Discreet and trustworthy when handling sensitive information
  • Driven, curious, and motivated to operate at a high level

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Experience in fast-paced startups or international environments
  • Previous experience in climate tech, sustainability, or AgTech settings
  • Exposure to legal/financial processes (contracts, notaries, documentation)
  • Strong experience with research, synthesis, and executive-level reporting

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change
  • Compensation expectations and our compensation philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.
  • Home Office Budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40 days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate.

The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach.

These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

Application Process

Roughly 6 hours across 3-6 weeks from CV-screening.

  • Interview with Talent & People Partner or Head of People (values & motivation)
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)

(optional third interview)

  • Challenge with 3+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)
  • Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling
  • Offer

How To Apply

A Winnin Intelligence é uma plataforma que, por meio de Inteligência Artificial, consolida dados das maiores plataformas de vídeo do mundo e te permite analisar, entender e criar estratégias data-driven de conteúdos em vídeo para transformar a sua fábrica de conteúdo, estar à frente da concorrência e se conectar verdadeiramente com a sua audiência. Afinal, quando diferentes talentos se unem em torno de um mesmo objetivo e compartilham conhecimento, coisas incríveis acontecem. É isso que buscamos viver todos os dias.

O time de Client Engagement é responsável pela satisfação, retenção e crescimento dos contratos de clientes, por meio de um acompanhamento da jornada do cliente, assegurando o sucesso ao longo de todas as etapas. Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Liderar e desenvolver um time, garantindo clareza de prioridades, papéis e objetivos.
  • Acompanhar metas da squad e impulsionar resultados.
  • Facilitar a colaboração entre diferentes áreas para maximizar valor entregue ao cliente.
  • Assegurar qualidade e consistência nas entregas, mantendo rituais de acompanhamento e evolução.
  • Ser o elo entre o time e a liderança, compartilhando aprendizados, avanços e necessidades.
  • Experiência prévia em liderança de times ou coordenação de projetos/contas. Perfil organizado, criativo, colaborativo e orientado a resultados.
  • Boa comunicação, visão estratégica e habilidade para lidar com diferentes perfis e áreas.
  • Capacidade de criar um ambiente de desenvolvimento, alinhamento e alto desempenho.
  • Inglês e Espanhol fluentes.

Teorias e técnicas psicoterápicas. Avaliação psicológica: fundamentos da medida psicológica. Instrumentos de avaliação: aplicação, avaliação e interpretação dos resultados. Técnicas de entrevista. About DoorDash

This position is dedicated to professionals with disabilities (PCD), in accordance with Brazilian Law No. 8.213/91 (Lei de Cotas).

At DoorDash, we believe diverse teams build better products. We are committed to providing an accessible, inclusive workplace with equal opportunities for all.

Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the hiring process and in the work environment. If you require any accommodation, please inform your recruiter at the beginning of the process.

Medical documentation may be requested in accordance with applicable legislation.

DoorDash is building the world’s most reliable on-demand logistics platform. Brazil is a strategic and growing engineering hub for DoorDash. Based in São Paulo, our teams build and scale systems that power millions of users globally. This is an opportunity to shape world-class logistics technology while growing your career in Brazil.

At DoorDash, we’re on a mission to empower local economies — and that mission drives everything we do. What started as food delivery has evolved into a technology and logistics platform designed to help people access anything in their city, from meals to everyday essentials. We’re building the future of local commerce, and we’re looking for team members excited to be part of that journey.

Joining DoorDash means working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where your ideas can shape products, impact millions of users, and help merchants, Dashers, and customers thrive. We value creativity, ownership, and continuous learning — and we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone can grow their careers while making a real difference.

We also care deeply about our team’s well‑being. DoorDash offers comprehensive benefits, including premium healthcare, paid parental leave, wellness reimbursements, and more — because we believe that when our people thrive, our communities thrive too.

About the Role

As the Engineering Manager, you will oversee a talented group of engineers, collaborating closely with product managers, operation and other cross‑functional partners. Your primary responsibility will be driving the successful execution of our product roadmap, ensuring the timely delivery of high‑quality solutions that meet both customer needs and business objectives. You will be key in fostering a collaborative and cross‑functional work environment and promoting effective communication and synergy amongst team members. This role is ideal for a strategic thinker with strong leadership skills who can balance technical excellence with business priorities.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Lead and grow a team of exceptional engineers, empowering through delegation, and delivering end‑to‑end engineering solutions.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Business leaders, and key stakeholders to determine the team's roadmap and vision, and manage execution against that roadmap.
  • Provide architectural guidance and professional development for a team of 9.
  • Encourage innovation, teamwork, implementation of cutting‑edge technologies, and outside‑of‑the‑box thinking.
  • Oversee the hiring process for your team, in partnership with recruiting, to grow a diverse and inclusive team.

We're excited about you because you have…

  • BS, M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science or related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in people management leading backend teams of 5+ engineers.
  • 7+ years of industry experience.
  • Experience working with remote teams in different time zone(s) and fluency in English.
  • Extensive experience as an engineer in a fast‑paced, product‑focused development environment.
  • Experience with distributed system design, system scaling, and performance optimization.
  • Hands‑on leadership and strong product intuition.
  • Humility - willing to get into the details and open to feedback.
  • Growth mindset - you're eager to expand your skill set and excited to carve out your career path in a hyper‑growth setting.
  • Adaptability, resiliency, and ability to thrive in ambiguity - things can change quickly, and you'll need to help the team evolve.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar a Manutenção Pelo Operador (MPO), utilizando check list e registrando as informações manualmente para assegurar que o equipamento esteja em plena condição de uso;
  • Preparar a máquina, verificando as ferramentas e informações para a usinagem utilizando as informações contidas na Ficha de Procedimento de Usinagem e o programa CNC para realizar o processo;
  • Realizar o balanceamento da peça na placa quando necessário, realizando avaliação do balanceamento de peças irregulares para regular o peso da peça na máquina;
  • Efetuar o alinhamento de contrapontas, utilizando o equipamento Relógio Comparador para assegurar que a peça não fique cônica;
  • Verificar a centragem e deslocamento da peça, observando se a peça está posicionada na máquina e corrigindo a posição se necessário para garantir o processo de usinagem;
  • Realizar a usinagem das peças, utilizando a OTF (Ordem Técnica de Fabricação), FTU (Ficha Técnica de Usinagem) e desenho da peça para assegurar a produção das peças dentro dos padrões estabelecidos;
  • Verificar a medição da peça, utilizando equipamentos de medição para checar se não há falhas para garantir a medição final conforme o desenho;
  • Registrar as medidas durante e ao final do processo de usinagem, preenchendo o PID (Plano de Inspeção Dimensional) para assegurar que as medidas estejam dentro dos padrões estabelecidos;
  • Alojar a peça de acordo com sua característica, acondicionando em embalagem ou com materiais adequados para evitar danos nas peças;
  • Realizar apontamento de produção, registrando a informação no Sistema ERP para manter a rastreabilidade e formar banco de dados para indicadores de produção.

São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Valores

  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.

Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Desenvolvimento de Projetos Sênior para atuar no desenvolvimento de projetos de instalações voltadas ao transporte de gás natural. O(a) profissional será responsável pela liderança técnica das entregas, garantindo conformidade às normas regulatórias e excelência na condução de projetos de alta complexidade.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de projetos de instalações para o transporte de gás natural, como gasodutos, pontos de entrega, pontos de recebimento, estações de compressão, entre outros.
  • Avaliar a documentação técnica dos projetos, garantindo atendimento às normas técnicas e regulamentações vigentes, atuando de forma colaborativa com equipes técnicas multidisciplinares.
  • Desenvolver solicitações de serviços para equipes técnicas e avaliar as propostas recebidas para execução dos serviços.
  • Liderar atividades relacionadas ao desenvolvimento dos projetos, assegurando o cumprimento dos objetivos técnicos, prazos e orçamentos.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos.
  • Desenvolver materiais e conduzir reuniões técnicas com clientes internos e externos.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia (Mecânica, Elétrica ou Civil).
  • Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de projetos.
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook).
  • Conhecimento em normas técnicas como ASME, ASTM, API, NBR, entre outras.

Diferencial

  • Pós-graduação.
  • Conhecimento em softwares de engenharia.
  • Experiência na área de O&G.

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo

  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare-se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor e Business Partner: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.

Por que trabalhar conosco?

Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo. Oferecemos oportunidades reais de aprendizado e evolução profissional, com programas estruturados e incentivo ao protagonismo de carreira. Nosso pacote de benefícios é completo e pensado para cuidar de você em todas as fases da vida.

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

description:
About Eurasia Group and GZERO Media

Eurasia Group is the world's leading global research and advisory firm. We help clients understand, anticipate, and respond to instability and opportunities everywhere they do business. Together with GZERO Media—the go-to source of first insight into geopolitics—and our full‑fledged events team, the Eurasia Group umbrella provides a complete political risk solution.

Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Washington, London, São Paulo, Brasília, Tokyo, Singapore, and San Francisco, as well as on‑the‑ground experts in more than a hundred countries in every region of the world. We are committed to analysis that is free of political bias and the influence of private interests.

Position Overview

Eurasia Group is seeking a high‑performing sales operations associate in São Paulo. This entry‑level sales operations support role includes a wide range of responsibilities, with an emphasis on proactive collaboration, strong communication, and organizational skills to complete tasks for a wide range of activities supporting our sales activities. In return, the hire will be a part of a dynamic sales operations team, working closely with business development staff and analysts, at the world’s market‑leading political risk advisory firm in an increasingly critical market space.

The sales operations associate will spend a majority of their time supporting our operations, business development, and analyst teams, reporting to the associate director, with a heavy focus on end‑to‑end management of conference call logistics and comprehensive administrative and operational support for the sales teams. This includes key responsibilities in account management (with a focus on CRM management and reporting), and responding to time‑sensitive, ad‑hoc sales requests as they arise. We are looking for someone with appropriate project management experience and a positive can‑do attitude. Given the varying nature of our business development needs and operations change management at the firm, you will need to be a quick learner, a versatile problem solver, and thrive in an entrepreneurial environment.

Responsibilities

  • Manage conference call logistics, including generation of client registration and attendance reports, call log maintenance, liaising with speakers to ensure a smooth presentation experience, troubleshooting technical issues, updating the conference call user manual, and providing training to research teams.
  • Support account management efforts across various client services teams including client interaction reporting, contact and account entitlement management in Salesforce, and other recurring account management activities.
  • Respond to client inquiries promptly and professionally, ensuring a positive customer experience.
  • Utilize Eurasia Group’s cloud‑based business intelligence platform to produce regular reports and ad‑hoc analysis of research production and consumption, and analyze readership trends in various segments of the client base.
  • Report regularly on interactions with specific clients to ensure compliance with research‑related regulations.
  • Direct website inquiries to the appropriate client services teams.
  • Approve requests for access to Eurasia Group content on various research aggregation platforms.
  • Ad hoc projects as required.

Required Skills

  • Strong English oral and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated professionalism, problem solving, teamwork skills, confidentiality, discretion, reliability, and judgment; positive can‑do attitude; someone who will “own” the role.
  • Agility and flexibility in response to changing priorities and needs.
  • Fluency with MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Zoom, and Salesforce.com CRM system and ability to pick up and learn new technologies as needed.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to meet deadlines.

Additional Requirements

  • Undergraduate/first‑level degree (e.g., bachelor’s degree) desired with coursework in business administration or related field.
  • 1‑2+ years’ experience in a professional services environment, especially a corporate sales, operations, or events function.
  • Experience interfacing with multinational corporations.
  • A strong interest in international affairs and politics, including an understanding of Eurasia Group’s core services.

At Eurasia Group, our mission is to provide the tools and understanding needed in a world where politics drives disruption. We put politics first for our clients, and we aspire to be the leading place people come to find out about the world. This requires us to maintain a company culture that puts people first. We are committed to fostering an environment that is empowering and globally minded. We firmly believe that bringing people with a variety of ideas and perspectives to the table makes our analysis stronger for our clients and creates a better workplace. Our leadership team is dedicated to embedding this approach into everything we do and how we lead because we care deeply about our work and our people.

title: Commercial Strategy Specialist
description:
AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI Growth Group

ABI’s Growth Division is the center of innovation and tech development within ABI, which is driving ABI’s growth by developing innovations for the core beer business and creating new hyper‑growth tech businesses. ABI Growth includes the following business lines: BEES (our business‑to‑business e‑commerce and SaaS business, also focused on new technologies), TaDa and Ze Delivery (our direct‑to‑consumer e‑commerce businesses), and several other high‑tech divisions, including fintech and venture capital.

This role will be largely dedicated to BEES, which is on a mission to transform ABI’s business‑to‑business sales model by putting customers and data at its heart. Whether you are a small to medium sized retailer or a supplying partner, BEES provides you with the tools, data, and insights you need to help your business thrive. Today, more than 2.5 million retailers across 19 countries use BEES every month to browse for products, place orders, earn rewards, arrange deliveries, manage invoices, and access business insights all from one place.

Learn more on how BEES keeps business buzzing at

About the Role

The Commercial Strategy Specialist is responsible for maximizing profitable growth across BEES Link 3P through strong governance, analytical rigor, and scalable operating standards. Aligned with our mission — to maximize profitable growth by institutionalizing pricing compliance, P&L governance, disciplined product prioritization, and scalable operating processes — this role plays a critical part in strengthening the structural foundations of our commercial model.

This position sits at the intersection of Commercial, Product, Finance, and Operations. The Commercial Strategy Specialist transforms complex business problems into data‑driven insights and scalable frameworks that protect margins, improve investment allocation, and accelerate disciplined decision‑making. This is a high‑impact role designed for a senior professional who combines strategic thinking with hands‑on analytical execution.

What you'll do

  • Own P&L governance for BEES Link 3P, consolidating partner‑level performance data and translating it into clear visibility on margin health, revenue quality, and profitability trends.
  • Provide broad‑ranging legal advice to other teams across ABI Growth, including relating to SaaS and licensing transactions, strategic commercial relationships, data monetization strategies, data privacy projects, and product counseling.
  • Build and maintain scalable operating frameworks — standard templates, decision criteria, governance protocols — that reduce dependency on ad hoc judgement and improve process consistency.
  • Drive product prioritization rigor by developing structured intake processes, effort‑impact scoring models, and backlog governance routines that align roadmap decisions with commercial outcomes.
  • Design and maintain investment evaluation frameworks that assess initiatives against a shared value logic, distinguishing between cost avoidance, governance improvement, and incremental revenue generation.
  • Develop and update reference models for take rate and GMV impact analysis, enabling leadership to make pricing and product decisions grounded in real partner data.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and inefficiencies across the OTC and GTM cycle, and lead initiatives to eliminate waste and improve execution speed without compromising governance standards.
  • Synthesize cross‑functional inputs — from Commercial, Finance, Product, and Operations — into integrated business reviews that surface risks early and enable proactive course correction.
  • Support JBP structuring and partner onboarding processes by providing analytical and governance scaffolding that ensures new engagements are commercially sound from the outset.

What you'll need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field; advanced degree (MBA, MSc) is a strong differentiator.
  • Experience in a business analytics, commercial operations, strategy, or financial governance role, ideally within a technology, marketplace, or CPG environment.
  • Proven ability to build and operationalize governance frameworks, pricing models, or P&L management tools in complex, multi‑stakeholder environments.
  • Strong analytical proficiency — advanced Excel/Google Sheets, SQL, or Python/R — with the ability to work directly with large datasets and translate findings into executive‑level insights.
  • Demonstrated experience with take rate modelling, GMV analysis, or margin management in a platform or marketplace business is a significant plus.
  • Desire to help build the legal function and data privacy program from the ground up.
  • Effective communicator who can synthesize complex analytical work into clear business narratives for senior leadership and cross‑functional partners.
  • Practical legal approach, focused on enabling the business strategy rather than a compliance‑first mindset.
  • Fully fluent in English and Portuguese; proficiency in Spanish is a plus.
